Browser reinstalls that keep settings now migrate the legacy snapshots-2 selection to the unified VI Snapshots capability, retaining its render workflows for the selected platforms. Snapshots remain selectable and revision scope is unchanged. Installers recognize the retired standalone render-image build workflow by its path and ownership markers: command-line installs remove it, while browser reinstalls include it in the existing stale-file cleanup preview. Unrecognized content is preserved, command-line retirement skips symlinks and directories, and source checkouts carrying release or relocation files are rejected before installation writes.
